description:
Configure GeoServer Service Security to restrict data modification capabilities. 

Goal: Lock down the WFS 'Transaction' operation so only Administrators can use it, while keeping WFS 'GetFeature' (read access) open to the public.

Instructions:
1. Log in to the GeoServer Web Admin interface (http://localhost:8080/geoserver/web/) with username 'admin' and password 'Admin123!'.
2. Navigate to Security > Services.
3. Add or modify rules for the 'wfs' service:
   - The 'Transaction' method must be restricted to the 'ADMIN' role.
   - The 'GetFeature' method (or all other methods) must remain accessible to the 'Anonymous' role (everyone).
4. Save your changes.
